description: Live identity doesn't recognize the user talking normally; match policy (minScore 0.62, margin 0.10, 8 s evidence, candidate 0.5) is an untuned guess for CAM++ while calibration measured same-speaker utterance centroids down to 0.44 and different-speaker max ~0.41. Add a dev-gated panel: sliders for minScore, candidateScore, minEvidenceMs, minMargin (and window agreement) per embedding space, persisted in settings.matchPolicies, plus a live readout per cluster of best/second score, evidence, agreement and the rejection reason so tuning uses real scores. Adaptive thresholds rejected: confirmations only sample same-speaker scores.
title: Dev match tuning: policy sliders and live match readout
